verdict.rationale: n8n has an official built-in 'MCP Client' core node (n8n-docs-20), which directly corresponds to plugging external MCP servers into n8n. It sits alongside n8n's documented agent and tool-using AI workflow features (n8n-docs-18, n8n-gh-9). The evidence is only the docs page title, though, with no detail on how it works. Missing for 10: any description of how MCP tools are exposed to n8n agents, supported transports and auth, configuration details, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP client works in practice.
